purpose: Verify an authenticated department user views only active announcements relevant to their role, program, and academic year.
preconditions: User is authenticated as a Student in a specific department, program, and academic year. Active announcements exist both matching and not matching the user's role, program, and academic year, along with a hidden announcement.
action_or_input: Authenticated Student requests the department announcement list.
expected_result: System retrieves active announcements, applies relevance filtering by role, program, and academic year, and returns only matching active announcements without exposing out-of-scope or hidden announcements; no announcement state is changed.

source_id: UC-DEPT-001 Alternative Flow: No relevant active announcement exists
purpose: Verify the system displays an empty-state message when no active announcements match the user's relevance scope.
preconditions: User is authenticated and authorized for the department context. No active announcements match the user's role, program, and academic year.
action_or_input: Authenticated user requests the department announcement list.
expected_result: System returns an empty announcement list and displays an empty-state message without exposing out-of-scope announcements or modifying announcement state.

purpose: Verify an authorized actor (Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD) can create and publish a complete announcement and notify relevant Students/Faculty.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a permitted role (Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD) in the department. Relevant Students and Faculty exist in the target role, program, and academic year scope.
action_or_input: Actor submits a new announcement with valid required content and target-scope information (role, program, academic year).
expected_result: System validates completeness, publishes the announcement as active for the defined target audience, and triggers notifications to relevant Students/Faculty within the target scope.

source_id: UC-DEPT-002 Alternative Flow: Required content or target information is invalid/missing
purpose: Verify announcement publication is blocked with validation feedback when required content or target-scope information is missing or invalid.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated with a permitted role (Faculty, Dept_Admin, or HOD) in the department.
action_or_input: Actor submits an announcement creation request with missing required content or missing/invalid target-scope information.
expected_result: System blocks publication, returns validation feedback, does not persist or publish the announcement, and does not send publication notifications.

source_id: UC-DEPT-003 Main Success Scenario / Alternative Flow: Edit
purpose: Verify HOD can edit an active department announcement with valid revised content and target information.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. An active department announcement exists.
action_or_input: HOD selects the active announcement, chooses Edit, and submits valid revised content and target-scope information.
expected_result: System verifies HOD authority, validates required announcement information, and saves the updated content and target-scope information on the announcement.

purpose: Verify HOD can hide an active department announcement so it is no longer shown in normal viewing.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. An active department announcement exists and is visible in normal announcement viewing.
action_or_input: HOD selects the active announcement and chooses Hide.
expected_result: System verifies HOD authority, updates the announcement state to hidden, and excludes the announcement from normal user viewing.

purpose: Verify HOD can delete an active department announcement.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. An active department announcement exists.
action_or_input: HOD selects the active announcement and chooses Delete.
expected_result: System verifies HOD authority and deletes the announcement so it is no longer active or displayed in normal announcement viewing.

purpose: Verify Faculty can submit a valid stock request within available inventory, placing it in Pending HOD Approval and notifying Dept_Admin and HOD.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized to request stock. A department inventory item exists with sufficient current quantity. Active Dept_Admin and HOD exist for the department.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a stock request selecting the inventory item and a requested quantity less than or equal to current inventory.
expected_result: System validates requested quantity against current inventory, creates the stock request in Pending HOD Approval state, notifies Dept_Admin of the new request, and notifies HOD that authorization is required.

source_id: UC-DEPT-004 Alternative Flow: Current inventory is insufficient
purpose: Verify a stock request exceeding current inventory is rejected at request time and not advanced to HOD approval.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated and authorized to request stock. A department inventory item exists with a known current quantity.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a stock request for the inventory item with a requested quantity greater than current inventory.
expected_result: System detects insufficient inventory, informs Faculty, does not advance or create a request in Pending HOD Approval state, and does not send HOD authorization notifications.

source_id: UC-DEPT-005 Main Success Scenario / Alternative Flow: Approved outcome
purpose: Verify HOD can approve a pending Faculty stock request so it transitions to Approved for Issuance and becomes available to Dept_Admin.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. A Faculty stock request exists in Pending HOD Approval state.
action_or_input: HOD opens the pending stock request and chooses Approve.
expected_result: System verifies HOD decision authority, transitions the request to Approved for Issuance, and makes it available to Dept_Admin for issuance without sending a final Issued/Rejected notification to Faculty.

purpose: Verify HOD can reject a pending Faculty stock request, terminating it in Rejected state and notifying the requesting Faculty.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. A Faculty stock request exists in Pending HOD Approval state.
action_or_input: HOD opens the pending stock request and chooses Reject.
expected_result: System verifies HOD decision authority, transitions the request to terminal Rejected state, does not make it available for Dept_Admin issuance, and notifies the requesting Faculty member of the Rejected outcome.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can issue stock for a HOD-approved request, decrementing inventory, appending an immutable issuance log, and notifying Faculty.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. A stock request exists in Approved for Issuance state for an inventory item with a recorded current quantity.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin selects the approved stock request and confirms issuance.
expected_result: System verifies issuance eligibility and Dept_Admin authority, marks the request/item as Issued, automatically decrements the inventory item's current quantity by the issued amount, appends an immutable stock-issuance movement record, and notifies the requesting Faculty member of the final Issued outcome.

purpose: Verify an authenticated Student or Faculty member can submit confidential feedback in New state and trigger a Dept_Admin notification.
preconditions: User is authenticated as a Student or Faculty member eligible to submit department feedback. Active Dept_Admin exists for the department.
action_or_input: Actor submits valid feedback information.
expected_result: System records the feedback in New state, enforces confidentiality access protections on the record, and notifies Dept_Admin of the new feedback submission.

purpose: Verify that when feedback submission fails, no partial feedback record is treated as submitted and the actor is informed of failure.
preconditions: User is authenticated as a Student or Faculty member eligible to submit feedback. A submission/persistence failure condition is triggered during feedback creation.
action_or_input: Actor submits feedback while the persistence/submission operation fails.
expected_result: System informs the actor of submission failure, does not record a partial or New feedback entry as successfully submitted, and does not notify Dept_Admin.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can perform initial review, categorize New feedback, mark it Resolved, and notify the submitter.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. Confidential feedback exists in New state and is accessible to Dept_Admin.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin opens the New feedback, categorizes it, and marks it Resolved.
expected_result: System records that initial review occurred, updates the feedback category and terminal status to Resolved, preserves confidentiality, and notifies the submitter of terminal resolution.

source_id: UC-DEPT-008 Alternative Flow: Simple issue closed during initial review
purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can close a simple issue during initial review and notify the submitter.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. Confidential feedback representing a simple issue exists in New state.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin performs initial review of the New feedback, categorizes it as applicable, and marks it Closed.
expected_result: System records initial review, transitions the feedback to terminal Closed status, preserves confidentiality, and notifies the submitter of closure.

source_id: UC-DEPT-008 Alternative Flow: Feedback remains non-terminal after initial review
purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can complete initial review and categorization while leaving feedback non-terminal and available for further handling including HOD oversight.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. Confidential feedback exists in New state.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin reviews and categorizes the New feedback without marking it Resolved or Closed.
expected_result: System records initial review and sets feedback to Under Review/Categorized (non-terminal), makes it accessible for further handling including HOD oversight under UC-DEPT-014, and does not send a terminal resolution/closure notification to the submitter.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can upload or modify a conflict-free class/lab timetable and save it directly without HOD approval.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin uploads a new timetable or modifies an existing timetable with non-overlapping class/lab slots.
expected_result: System checks for overlapping slots, finds no conflicts, and saves the timetable directly.

source_id: UC-DEPT-009 Alternative Flow: Slot conflict detected
purpose: Verify the system blocks saving a timetable upload or modification when overlapping slots are detected and displays conflict information.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. Existing or candidate timetable contains slots that overlap with the submitted change.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a timetable upload or modification containing overlapping slots.
expected_result: System detects the overlapping-slot conflict, blocks saving, displays conflict information, and leaves the persisted timetable unchanged.

source_id: UC-DEPT-010 Main Success Scenario (General/non-official detail update)
purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update general/non-official department information and have it saved directly.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a valid edit to general/non-official department information.
expected_result: System validates the entered data and saves the updated general department information immediately without requiring HOD approval.

source_id: UC-DEPT-010 Main Success Scenario (Official department detail proposal)
purpose: Verify that when Dept_Admin edits an official department detail (such as Name or Core Policies), it is recorded as Pending HOD Approval and not published before approval.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. Current effective official department details (e.g., Name or Core Policies) exist.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a valid edit to an official department detail (e.g., department Name or Core Policies, excluding Headship identity).
expected_result: System validates the entered data, records the proposed change in Pending HOD Approval state, and retains the previous effective official department detail without publishing the unapproved change.

purpose: Verify invalid department detail updates are not saved and return validation feedback.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits invalid department detail data in Department Settings.
expected_result: System rejects the update, displays validation feedback, and neither saves general changes nor creates a Pending HOD Approval proposal.

purpose: Verify Faculty can view permitted department lab resource profiles and relevant issued-stock history.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated for the department. Department lab resource profiles and issued-stock history records within Faculty scope exist.
action_or_input: Faculty opens Department Resources and selects the lab resources view and the issued-stock history view.
expected_result: System retrieves and displays permitted lab resource profiles and relevant issued-stock history within Faculty scope without disclosing out-of-scope resource information.

source_id: UC-DEPT-011 Alternative Flow: No data exists in the selected view
purpose: Verify the system displays an empty-state message when no resource data exists in the selected Faculty resource view.
preconditions: Faculty is authenticated for the department. No lab resource profiles or relevant issued-stock history records exist in the selected view.
action_or_input: Faculty opens Department Resources and selects the view that has no data.
expected_result: System displays an empty-state message and does not disclose out-of-scope resource data.

purpose: Verify HOD can approve a pending official department-detail change so it is published and becomes effective.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. A Dept_Admin-proposed official department-detail change (e.g., Name or Core Policies) exists in Pending HOD Approval state.
action_or_input: HOD opens the pending official department change and chooses Approve.
expected_result: System verifies HOD decision authority, marks the change approved/published, and updates the effective official department data to the proposed value.

purpose: Verify HOD can reject a pending official department-detail change while retaining the current effective department data.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. A Dept_Admin-proposed official department-detail change exists in Pending HOD Approval state.
action_or_input: HOD opens the pending official department change and chooses Reject.
expected_result: System verifies HOD decision authority, records the change as Rejected, and retains the existing effective official department data unchanged.

purpose: Verify HOD can oversee feedback that has undergone initial Dept_Admin review, apply a terminal status (Resolved or Closed), and notify the submitter.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. Confidential feedback exists that has already undergone Dept_Admin initial review (non-terminal Under Review/Categorized state) and is accessible under confidentiality rules.
action_or_input: HOD opens the reviewed feedback, performs oversight/resolution, and marks the feedback Resolved (or Closed).
expected_result: System records HOD oversight, transitions the feedback to terminal Resolved (or Closed) state, preserves confidentiality, and notifies the submitter of terminal resolution/closure.

source_id: UC-DEPT-014 Alternative Flow: HOD reviews without changing terminal status
purpose: Verify HOD can review initially-reviewed feedback without applying a terminal status, leaving it in its existing reviewed state.
preconditions: HOD is authenticated for the department. Confidential feedback exists in a non-terminal state after Dept_Admin initial review.
action_or_input: HOD opens and reviews the feedback without marking it Resolved or Closed.
expected_result: Feedback remains in its existing reviewed non-terminal state, confidentiality is preserved, and no terminal resolution/closure notification is sent to the submitter.

purpose: Verify an authenticated actor viewing a department user profile sees only fields permitted for their role and relationship (e.g., Faculty viewing a Student in their course).
preconditions: Actor is authenticated as Faculty in the department. A Student profile exists in the department for a Student enrolled in the Faculty member's course.
action_or_input: Faculty opens the profile of the Student enrolled in their course.
expected_result: System identifies the Faculty role and course relationship, applies the profile visibility matrix, and displays detailed permitted Student profile information without disclosing out-of-scope data.

source_id: UC-DEPT-015 Alternative Flow: Faculty requests a Student not in the Faculty member's courses
purpose: Verify Faculty is not provided detailed Student profile information for a Student who is not enrolled in the Faculty member's courses.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated as Faculty in the department. A department Student profile exists for a Student not enrolled in any of the Faculty member's courses.
action_or_input: Faculty requests the profile of the Student not in their courses.
expected_result: System applies the profile visibility matrix and does not provide the detailed Student view for that Student.

source_id: UC-DEPT-015 Alternative Flow: Privacy-protected sensitive personal data excluded from HOD/Dept_Admin view
purpose: Verify privacy-protected sensitive personal data is excluded when HOD or Dept_Admin views a full department user profile.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated as HOD or Dept_Admin in the department. A department user profile exists containing both standard department profile fields and privacy-protected sensitive personal data.
action_or_input: HOD (or Dept_Admin) opens the department user profile.
expected_result: System displays the full permitted department profile fields while excluding privacy-protected sensitive personal data.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can perform an authorized profile-management update on a Faculty, Student, or Alumni profile within the department.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. A Faculty, Student, or Alumni profile record exists within the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin selects the department profile record and submits valid profile-management changes.
expected_result: System validates the submitted profile data and applies the authorized change within department scope.

purpose: Verify invalid profile-management changes submitted by Dept_Admin are rejected and not applied.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. A department user profile record exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits invalid profile data for the selected profile record.
expected_result: System fails validation, does not apply the invalid change, and preserves the existing profile record unchanged.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update department lab equipment and resource-profile details with valid data.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. A department lab/resource profile exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin selects the lab/resource profile and submits valid updated equipment/resource details.
expected_result: System validates and saves the updated lab/resource profile details.

purpose: Verify invalid lab/resource profile updates submitted by Dept_Admin are not saved.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department. A department lab/resource profile exists.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin selects the lab/resource profile and submits invalid equipment/resource details.
expected_result: System fails validation, does not save the update, and preserves the existing lab/resource profile details unchanged.

purpose: Verify an authenticated Student can view department academic program information and applicable timetable information.
preconditions: Student is authenticated for the department. Academic program information and a timetable applicable to the Student's context are published.
action_or_input: Student opens Academic Information/Timetable and selects the academic program information view and the timetable view.
expected_result: System retrieves and displays the academic program information and applicable timetable for the Student's context without modifying any data.

source_id: UC-DEPT-018 Alternative Flow: No applicable timetable/program data is published
purpose: Verify the system shows an empty/unavailable state when no academic program or timetable data is published for the Student's context.
preconditions: Student is authenticated for the department. No academic program information or timetable is published for the Student's context.
action_or_input: Student opens Academic Information/Timetable and selects the academic program information or timetable view.
expected_result: System displays an empty/unavailable state message and modifies no data.

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can insert a valid stock receipt record, updating current inventory, appending an immutable insertion movement record, and displaying updated inventory tracking.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a valid stock insertion/receipt record in Inventory Management.
expected_result: System creates or updates the inventory record and current quantity, appends an immutable stock-insertion movement record, and displays updated current inventory tracking information to Dept_Admin.

source_id: UC-DEPT-019 Alternative Flow: Invalid stock data
purpose: Verify invalid stock insertion/update data is rejected with validation feedback without altering inventory or audit history.
preconditions: Dept_Admin is authenticated for the department.
action_or_input: Dept_Admin submits a stock insertion/receipt record containing invalid stock data (e.g., invalid/non-positive quantity or missing required item data).
expected_result: System rejects the insertion/update with validation feedback and leaves current inventory quantities and the immutable movement log unchanged.

purpose: Verify central Institute Admin can record a valid time-bounded HOD or Dept_Admin role assignment/reassignment satisfying authority, tenure, and unique-active-role constraints.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated as authorized central Institute Admin (or equivalent central authority). Target employee is an eligible institute employee for the department.
action_or_input: Institute Admin selects the department, role (HOD or Dept_Admin), incoming employee, and a valid time-bounded validity interval that does not violate single-active-role uniqueness.
expected_result: System validates central assignment authority, time-bounded tenure, and unique-active-role constraints, records the assignment/reassignment, and confirms the recorded assignment and its validity interval.

source_id: UC-DEPT-020 Alternative Flow: Proposed assignment violates unique active-role cardinality
purpose: Verify the system blocks recording a department role assignment that would violate the exactly-one-active-role constraint.
preconditions: Actor is authenticated as authorized central Institute Admin. An active HOD (or Dept_Admin) assignment already exists for the department covering the proposed validity interval without a valid transition.
action_or_input: Institute Admin attempts to create a concurrent active assignment for the same department and role that would result in more than one active holder.
expected_result: System blocks the inconsistent assignment, requires a valid transition, and does not persist a cardinality-violating role assignment.

purpose: Verify that when a recorded HOD (or Dept_Admin) reassignment becomes effective, outgoing role access is immediately revoked, incoming access is immediately granted, exactly one active holder exists, and Headship is synchronized for HOD.
preconditions: A department has an existing active HOD. A valid time-bounded HOD reassignment to an incoming employee has been recorded via UC-DEPT-020.
action_or_input: The recorded HOD reassignment reaches its effective time and triggers UC-DEPT-022.
expected_result: System immediately revokes the outgoing HOD's department-role access, immediately grants HOD department-role access to the incoming employee, ensures exactly one active HOD exists for the department, and synchronizes the displayed department Headship to the incoming active HOD.

source_id: UC-DEPT-022 Alternative Flow: Initial assignment with no outgoing holder
purpose: Verify that when an initial HOD or Dept_Admin assignment with no outgoing holder becomes effective, outgoing revocation is skipped and incoming role access is granted while preserving the single-active-role invariant.
preconditions: A department has no outgoing holder for the selected role (HOD or Dept_Admin). A valid initial time-bounded assignment for an incoming employee has been recorded via UC-DEPT-020.
action_or_input: The recorded initial assignment reaches its effective time and triggers UC-DEPT-022.
expected_result: System skips outgoing revocation, grants the corresponding department-role access to the incoming employee, establishes exactly one active holder for that role, and synchronizes displayed Headship if the role is HOD.

source_id: UC-DEPT-022 Exception Flow: Transition must not authorize role state violating BR-DEPT-022 or BR-DEPT-024
purpose: Verify an effective-time role transition failure or conflict does not leave an unauthorized active-role state violating unique-active-role or immediate-transition rules.
preconditions: A department has an existing active role holder and a recorded reassignment triggers UC-DEPT-022 under a condition where revoking outgoing access or applying the transition atomically fails.
action_or_input: UC-DEPT-022 executes when an error prevents completing both outgoing revocation and incoming grant consistently.
expected_result: System does not accept or authorize a resulting role state with multiple active holders or with both outgoing and incoming holders simultaneously holding active role access.
